interpretation_limits: Visible group alphaT identifies which component loses transmittance. It does not alone prove what original legacy group RGB caused a silver fragment.

C versus AA has identical geometry/occlusion. A silver fragment disappearing together with C2/asset weight loss must not be reported as a foreground-safe road handover.
